# Mark Westfall Roofing (San Pedro & South Bay, CA)
> 3rd-Generation Family-Owned Roofing Contractor Serving Southern California Since 1946.

## Core Roofing & Exterior Services
- **Residential Roof Replacement & Repairs:** Tear-offs, re-roofs, leak detection, and storm repairs.
- **Composition Shingles & Cool Roofs:** Owens Corning TruDefinition Duration Cool, Malarkey Vista AR / Legacy, CertainTeed Presidential Shake TL.
- **Clay & Concrete Tile Systems:** Authentic US Tile "S" Red clay, Eagle Roofing extruded concrete tile, Westlake Royal, Boral CedarLite, and tile relay with upgraded synthetic underlayment.
- **Solar Panel Removal & Reinstallation (R&R):** Full coordination of solar panel removal and re-mounting during roof replacement.
- **Dry Rot, Gutters & Skylights:** Wood fascia/sheathing dry rot repair, custom sheet metal flashing, seamless rain gutters, Lane-Aire skylights, and Rapid Ridge attic ventilation.
- **Commercial & Multi-Family Roofing:** Built-Up Roofing (BUR), CertainTeed Flintlastic SA modified bitumen, and Title 24 reflective silicone roof coatings (APOC / Tropical). Notable commercial clients include Costco, Marriott, Residence Inn Torrance, Robinson Helicopter, Extended Stay America, and Boston Market.
